upstream.blockEvidence: prerequisites demand Kubernetes+Agent Substrate+Go+ko+registry; sandbox has none (measured r164)

role: Declarative fleet discipline adopted from ax's Task/Workspace/Model pattern, applied to our 16-service single-host fleet. The platform stays blocked; the pattern is law.

rules.text: Every fleet service gets a manifest in sovereign/fleet/fleet.yaml before or at boot. A service without a manifest is unmanaged drift — the auditor hunts it by port-scan. Evidence: first audit found 6 unmanaged services (3033,3035-3039).

No service is admitted without a declared memory limit, backed by a measured RSS. Motivating evidence: r163 — decision-brain's model load (2GB peak, undeclared) was OOM-killed twice and degraded fleet memory trust.
Heavy services declare a suspendPolicy (e.g. idle-unload-120s) instead of being killed by the OOM killer. SIGKILL = unplanned eviction = incident to record, never a lifecycle step.
Preinstalled environments (venvs, model caches, pinned repos) are declared as workspaces in the manifest — ax's Workspace pattern: setup once, declaratively, then every restart starts warm.
No status without a receipt: phase is one word, truth lives in measured conditions (health probe, RSS, port). The auditor emits audit-latest.json as the evidence record.
Reality wins over declarations: when the audit measures something different from the manifest (wrong healthPath, wrong limit), the manifest is corrected in the same wave, not argued with.
Cluster-grade platforms (ax, Agent Substrate, k8s) are adopted as doctrine, not pretending to run them. Activation route documented; re-examine when a real cluster exists.

activationRoutes.condition: real Kubernetes cluster with Agent Substrate becomes available
activationRoutes.action: translate sovereign.io/v1alpha1 manifests to ax.io/v1alpha1 Tasks, bind decision-brain as suspend/resume Task with its 2048MB limit
run fleet-manifests-audit.mjs on a schedule; a new VIOLATION opens a wave automatically

whyNotRevenue: ax is orchestration infrastructure — it sells nothing and pays nothing. Accepted for discipline value: the manifest+audit layer prevents the class of silent drift and OOM incidents that threaten revenue systems (curation, money-mover) rather than earning directly.
